traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Faxian NEVER mentions the name of the king (Chandragupta II) in his accounts; he only records his experience of the administration.
Faxian's focus was purely religious (Buddhism); do not expect detailed political accounts like those found in Megasthenes' Indika.
Confusing Faxian (5th Century) with Xuanzang (7th Century - Harshavardhana period).

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Centralized around Magadha and Pataliputra.
  • Description of the Ganges valley civilization.

Personalities

  • Faxian: Buddhist monk and explorer.
  • Chandragupta II: The ruling emperor.

Mindmap: Key Observations

  • Socio-Economic State
    • 'Chandalas' existence outside city gates (untouchability).
    • Mild administrative justice system.
    • General prosperity and use of Cowrie shells for trade.
  • Religious Landscape
    • Flourishing of Mahayana and Hinayana Buddhism.
    • Presence of free hospitals and charity inns.
